name: spellkave_entity
label: Spellkave Entity
description: Read an entity's identity row by entity_id (numeric id, 'entity:N', or a manifest key) — entity_def_id, name, kind, and stack quantity — or null if it does not resolve. General-purpose quantity surface outside the PLAYER inventory flow (e.g. verifying a coin stack shrank by a purchase price, or a purchased ware landed with the right count); spellkave_inventory and spellkave_item_detail also carry quantity, while spellkave_entity_container exposes containment only, never quantity.

entity_id.description: Entity identifier (numeric id, 'entity:N', or a manifest key). Returns its identity row — entity_def_id, name, kind, and stack quantity — or null if it does not resolve. General-purpose quantity surface outside the PLAYER inventory flow (spellkave_inventory and spellkave_item_detail also carry quantity); spellkave_entity_container returns containment only, never quantity.
